snapshot: WHO African Region. On the front line of the Ebola outbreak in neighbouring Democratic Republic of the Congo, with a health system that depends heavily on external financing.

agenda.title: Keeping Ebola out
agenda.text: With the outbreak across the border, Uganda ordered a 21-day quarantine for citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and has been running joint cross-border preparedness work with Rwanda. Africa CDC awarded Uganda a grant of 102 billion shillings for epidemic response in November.

agenda.title: National health insurance, again
agenda.text: The ministry has revived its push for a National Health Insurance Scheme.

agenda.title: A new medicines regulator
agenda.text: Cabinet has appointed a head for the new Drug and Health Products Authority.

nl.text: The Netherlands funds sexual and reproductive health and rights work in Uganda.

items.title: SAY Plus+: Strengthening Adolescents and Youth Rights and Empowerment
items.who: Netherlands with Denmark, Sweden and Iceland
items.text: The Netherlands committed more than US$16 million to this multi-donor programme for the health, rights and well-being of young people.
